perspective:
From Alice Lim’s available perspective:

- She knows she is Alice Lim, an Asian woman and dental hygienist, and that Austin Moreno is her old friend from high school. They have stayed close and often discuss personal and professional lives.
- She knows Austin works as an insurance agent.
- She observed Austin becoming reserved when they talked about work. She suspected he might be hiding something about his job performance. She felt concerned and curious, so she invited him to coffee.
- Alice heard Austin say: it was “nothing really,” just “the usual ups and downs”; he wasn’t sure how to handle “a few things at work”; and it was “complicated.”
- Alice inferred that Austin might be considering a career change because of dissatisfaction at work. She felt worried about his well-being and decided to share her own healthcare experiences and discuss career paths.
- Alice asked Austin if he had thought about changing careers. Austin said he had thought about it but didn’t know what other paths he could take, and asked for her suggestions.
- Alice suggested healthcare, said it always needs dedicated people, and offered to tell him more and connect him with contacts. Austin said that sounded interesting and wanted to know more about her experiences and what it involves.
- Alice sensed Austin was hesitant about changing careers because of fear of the unknown. She felt frustration mixed with empathy and told him that career changes are daunting but many succeed, citing her friend Lara who switched to healthcare in her late 30s and was happier. She said growth comes from leaving comfort zones and offered her support.
- Austin replied that this was inspiring but he worried about risks and initial struggle. He thanked her and said her support and real success stories helped.
- Seeing Austin’s openness, Alice felt encouraged and hopeful. She suggested he talk to a career counselor and offered to connect him with friends in healthcare. Austin said that would be helpful and appreciated the connections.
- Alice said it was about taking first steps and that she would set up a meeting next week. Austin thanked her and said he was looking forward to it.
- After several discussions and meetings, Alice believed Austin was ready to take the next steps and appreciated her help. She felt satisfaction and joy.
- Alice told Austin she was proud of his steps and asked how he felt. Austin said he was excited, a bit nervous, and mostly grateful. Alice proposed regular check-ins; Austin agreed, saying it would keep him focused and that her perspective helped.
